invariants.C0: no payload (no answer block); the T arms likewise have none
invariants.C2_vs_C3: only the guidance value differs; both are C1 plus guidance (the item's wording pair)
invariants.C4_triggered: not a cell: C4a when the frozen GraphToolSet trigger fires on the omit_node answer, else C1
invariants.C4a_vs_C1: only the appended verification block differs; the block is identical in every variant

omit_edge_vs_vcomplete.identical: every endpoint including C* (bytes and order), every other match, and every other field

omit_node_vs_vcomplete.identical: every other match and endpoint (bytes and order), the target endpoint, endpoint ids and order, and every other field

invariants.scope: the omission and visibility invariants cover the graph payload (C1-C3, and C4a without its verification block); the C4a lexical block may expose C* by design (D11.6)

parameters.locagent_unindexed: D12.7: X or a J-reported caller of X has no LocAgent node (function node, or the first direct __init__ of a class node: class_node_init)
